contract.acquisition_channels: adapter list with capability and authority constraints
contract.attribution_method: immutable signal -> offer -> action -> transaction -> fulfillment chain
contract.unit_economics: price - authorized variable cost - fulfillment cost
contract.replication_rule: one verified external economic event before cloning
contract.commerce_cell_template: offer + price + buyer + acquisition + payment + fulfillment + attribution + truth + kill + replication

cube_behavior.input: Gold signals plus existing proven commerce cells
cube_behavior.silo_rule: A silo is a presentation/distribution tenant of an economic loop, not the economic loop itself.
cube_behavior.promotion_rule: Do not treat exposure, clicks, rows, generated pages, or payment links as revenue.
cube_behavior.authority_rule: External effects remain approval-gated until a channel has an explicitly authorized machine-action policy.

white_label.public_surface: DreamLedger compiled surface first; domain-neutral renderer later
